limitations: All 422 original baseline controls are preserved in traceability; this is not a claim that every historical control has been individually reimplemented or browser-verified.
Advanced controls represent v2 configuration and prototype user flows, not real execution of all Lyzr/provider/infrastructure capabilities.
External integration, permissions, scheduler, sandbox, tests and generated-app deployment remain explicitly simulated unless a separate live adapter demonstrates execution.
Project workflow configurations are stored in Project.workflow and included in cloud workspace persistence; demo mode alone can migrate legacy local workflow records.
